استعلمنا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَمْنَا (istaʕlamnā) /is.taʕ.lam.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اُسْتُعْلِمْنَا (ustuʕlimnā) /us.tuʕ.lim.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
